Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly deduced that Harry L. Fraser was British. While the search results correctly identified the 1934 film *Fighting Through* as "American," the Planner failed to notice this crucial detail in the search results (which explicitly stated "1934 American Western film") and erroneously concluded the director was from the same country (British) as the director of *The Fall Of A Saint*. This led to the wrong final answer.
